name: Control-NeRF
aliases: Editable Feature Volumes for Scene Rendering and Manipulation
definition: A novel view synthesis method that decouples scene-specific geometry and appearance from the rendering model by learning dense feature volumes for each scene and a single shared neural rendering network that generalizes across scenes.
summary: Control-NeRF is a novel view synthesis method that decouples geometry and appearance into interpretable feature volumes, enabling 3D-aware scene manipulation unlike standard NeRF.
